description: This file defines an interface for an internal memory storage grain used by Orleans, providing asynchronous methods to read, write, and delete grain state data.

classes.name: IMemoryStorageGrain
classes.description: Interface for internal memory storage grain used by Orleans in-memory storage provider, supporting asynchronous state operations.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the grain state data from memory store for a given grain key.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the grain state data in memory store for a given grain key.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the grain state data from memory store for a given grain key and eTag.
